subject.title: feat: discover OpenCode and Pi sessions on paired nodes

question: Should OpenCode and Pi session catalogs ship as official OpenClaw plugins with detection-based default activation, or remain external plugins using the existing catalog seam?
rationale: The generic technical boundary already exists, but official ownership, bundled distribution, automatic activation, and privacy defaults are product-policy choices that automation cannot safely select.

options.title: Sponsor official plugins
options.body: Build plugin-owned, view-only catalogs with per-node opt-in, bounded transcript reads, and visible disable controls after local tool detection.

options.title: Route to external plugins
options.body: Keep OpenClaw's generic catalog seam unchanged and have independently maintained OpenCode and Pi packages publish through ClawHub.

options.title: Defer catalog parity
options.body: Retain Codex and Claude coverage only until stronger demand or more stable upstream session contracts emerge.

recommendation.title: Sponsor official plugins
recommendation.body: Build plugin-owned, view-only catalogs with per-node opt-in, bounded transcript reads, and visible disable controls after local tool detection.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue supplies a concrete product boundary and appears to be seeking sponsorship of official plugin behavior and defaults.
